newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines has successfully defended peso-Ramos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines has successfully defended peso-Ramos.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank intervention has successfully defended the peso following the fall in the Thai baht, President Fidel Ramos told reporters on Wednesday.

He quoted Bank Governor Gabriel Singson as saying that "with this intervention, which included raising of overnight rates...the peso has been effectively protected from these speculative attacks against it by some quarters."
Ramos said a stable peso was crucial in the fight against inflation.
He said inflation in June -- expected to be announced later this week -- would be within the range of May's year-on-year 4.2 percent rise or even lower.
A Central Bank official earlier this week put the figure at 3.9 percent.
"(Low inflation) is one of the most important...weapons against poverty," he added at his weekly news conference.
